title: Separate an actual-forcing inverse failure from a bounded output projection
statement: At X=lambda G+aZ,a^2+lambda^2=1,the strict u=delta_ZJ pointwise operator a(N_Z+2)+lambda delta_Zpartial_G has exponentially growing chaos inverses. A bounded smooth Fourier residual,including an actual admissible conservative first-order perturbation forcing,has no weak L2 solution. Output projection has a different bounded inverse and a finite one-residual-value action with exact energy pi^2(1+3a^2)||R||_2^2/(32a^2).

requires: 0<lambda<1 and the specified strict noise-divergence interface
For projected implementation,an acquired value of prescribed R at its actual correlated Gaussian point
provides: Weak chaos tests force unique finite-sector inverses;nonpolynomial kernels cannot repair failure
Actual first forcing lambda(f prime+K_f) has noncancelling Hermite coefficients
Projected J=-a^-1(N_X+2)^-1E[R|X] controls output Stein tests and preserves source centering
Gaussian-reserve full-density Taylor remainder charges the actual random action
